subject: Q3 renewal: usage recap, proposed upsell & next steps
messages:
From: Dana Morris <dana.morris@seastone.ai>
To: ava_chen@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: linda.park@seastone.ai, accts-payable@seastone.ai
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 renewal planning: usage recap and timing

Hi Ava / Ben,

Hope you both had a good week. With our renewal window approaching (early Nov), procurement wants a concise recap of our Q3 consumption and any recommended changes to commit/term. A few items to help us prioritize: 

- Q3 token spend vs forecast (we ran ~3.4B tokens, +22% vs forecast)
- Latency regressions we surfaced in mid-Aug during peak (impacted two pipelines)
- ROI ask from our product team — want to confirm value uplift by model changes or commit adjustments

Can Redwood provide: a short one-pager of usage trends, a suggested commit tier to avoid overages, and a pro-forma that includes a Dedicated uplift option (we may want predictable throughput)?

We can share an internal list of SLAs we need if that helps. Suggest a 30-minute sync next week.

Thanks,
Dana Morris
Procurement Lead
Seastone Analytics
(attachment: internal-cost-snap.pdf)
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Morris <dana.morris@seastone.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, linda.park@seastone.ai
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 12:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal planning: usage recap and timing

Hi Dana — thanks for the clear ask.

I've attached a compact usage summary for Q3 and a sample latency chart we pulled for the two affected pipelines. Key takeaways:

- Consumption: 3.41B tokens in Q3 (steady month-over-month growth; see Q3-seastone-usage-summary.csv).
- Overages: modest (2 instances) tied to unexpected batch jobs on Aug 14–16; those correlated with increased seq lengths.
- Latency: median tail increased ~80ms during spikes; P95 remained within your previous SLA ~820ms. Sample trace attached (latency-sample-aug2026.png).
- Economic: switching 25% of high-volume pipelines to a Dedicated pool reduces per-token unit cost by ~18% and removes variable overage risk.

Suggested next steps (proposed for our sync):
1) Walk through the attached usage CSV and confirm any outlier jobs you want excluded.
2) Review two commercial paths: extend existing term with a higher commit OR add a Dedicated pool pilot for the top 3 pipelines.
3) If comfortable, we'll produce a clean proposal (with revised pricing and SLO language) and send via DocuSign.

Available windows next week: Tue 9/29 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 9/30 14:00–15:00 PT — propose Tue 9/29 10:00.

Thanks — I’ll loop Marissa (CS) to cover adoption/QA items.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0143
(attachments: Q3-seastone-usage-summary.csv, latency-sample-aug2026.png)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: ava_chen@redwood.ai, dana.morris@seastone.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, linda.park@seastone.ai
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal planning: usage recap and timing

Looks good — short technical notes for the call:

- The Aug spike appears to be two backfilled jobs that used 3x typical sequence length; with prefix caching and a minor model switch we estimate ~30% cost reduction for those flows.
- Recommended pilot: 1x Dedicated node group for the top 3 pipelines (4xA10 equivalent) with an autoscale floor to cover your weekday peaks.
- SLOs: we can guarantee 95th latency threshold + dedicated capacity credits for extended outages for the pilot.

I’ll prepare a one-slide ops impact summary for the call.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
(attachment: ops-impact-slide.pdf)
From: Dana Morris <dana.morris@seastone.ai>

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, linda.park@seastone.ai, accts-payable@seastone.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal planning: usage recap and timing

Thanks Ava / Ben — Tue 9/29 10:00 PT works for us. A couple quick asks ahead of the call so I can pull stakeholders: 

- Could you include a pro-forma for a 12-month vs 24-month term showing per-token blended price and an option line for a Dedicated pilot?
- Please call out any migration effort or engineering touchpoints for moving pipelines to Dedicated. Our eng lead (Linda) will want that detail.
- Could finance get a draft invoice/quote we can route to procurement and AP?

If you can send the pro-forma and a short migration checklist before the call, we should be able to make a go/no-go decision quickly.

Dana
Dana Morris
Procurement Lead, Seastone Analytics
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Morris <dana.morris@seastone.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, linda.park@seastone.ai, accts-payable@seastone.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal planning: usage recap and timing — materials attached

Dana — great to confirm the time. Per your asks I’ve attached an updated proposal (Seastone_proposal_v2.pdf) that includes:

- Two commercial lanes: 12-month and 24-month (with step-down pricing), plus a Dedicated pilot line item with estimated savings.
- Blended per-token examples at your current mix and with a 25% shift to Dedicated.
- Migration checklist (low friction): small SDK change + routing policy update; typical migration window 2–3 sprints with one SE touchpoint.
- Draft invoice/quote and a DocuSign link for faster approval.

Action items for the call (Tue 10:00 PT):
- Seastone: confirm which pipelines to include in the Dedicated pilot (list any exclusions).
- Redwood: finalize pilot sizing and pull final SLO language for the contract.
- Finance: confirm preferred billing cadence and PO requirements.

Links: https://docusign.com/Seastone_RDW_proposal_v2 | https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Seastone-Renewal

Talk shortly — thanks all.

Regards,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
